name: Community Litter Pick
description: Join us for our monthly community litter pick. We meet at the South Car Park at 10am, spend a couple of hours cleaning up the beach and dunes, then usually grab a coffee together after. All equipment provided — just bring yourself.

name: TBS Pop-Up
description: Come and see the latest collection in person. We'll have the full range available to try and buy, plus a few pieces that haven't made it to the site yet. Free entry, all welcome.

name: Community Litter Pick
description: Our August litter pick heads out to Hengistbury Head — one of our favourite spots on the South Coast and one that needs a bit of love. Meet at the main car park at 10am.
